field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: Names both mandated local GGUF model ids.
field_principles.arc_level_solve_claim_count: Must stay zero because this is not a solve task.
field_principles.arc_target_licensed_generalization_ready: Equals one only if every powered held fold passes.
field_principles.baseline_harm_controls_by_fold: Prevents a treatment from hiding baseline harm.
field_principles.cuda_and_gpu_offload_receipts_by_model: Carries the terminal upstream CUDA/offload evidence.
field_principles.field_principles: Gives one audit reason per required field.
field_principles.field_provenance: Maps every field to the spec and producer.
field_principles.frozen_policy_paths_and_hashes: Pins the source and constants reused without edits.
field_principles.hidden_game_source_access_count: Must stay zero for hidden-source discipline.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal verdict with no solve claim.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declares aggregation from the frozen upstream live canary.
field_principles.missing_underpowered_or_harmful_folds: Preserves folds that cannot support promotion.
field_principles.models_used: Lists model ids evaluated as frozen policy cells.
field_principles.no_refit_receipts_by_fold: Shows no threshold, prompt, adapter, or predicate was retuned.
field_principles.outer_loop_ground_truth_search_count: Must stay zero for self-discovery discipline.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Records gate, registry, model, CUDA, timeout, and seed checks.
field_principles.protected_files_unchanged: Confirms registry, ops, trace, and conductor files stayed unchanged.
field_principles.raw_output_paths_and_hashes: Pins each held-fold raw response row.
field_principles.registry_precheck_path_hash_and_target_r: Proves this is not a public solve target.
field_principles.registry_update_count: Must stay zero because no solve is banked.
field_principles.row_counts_by_fold_and_stratum: Shows fold and stratum sample sizes.
field_principles.solve_provenance: States live-agent self-discovery without solve credit.
field_principles.source_model_weight_mutation_count: Must stay zero because model weights are immutable.
field_principles.status: States complete versus blocked without hiding partial work.
field_principles.structured_gate_receipt: Proves Exp6307 ready score is exactly one before execution.
field_principles.upstream_path_hash_and_terminal_class: Pins the Exp6307 canary and Exp6295 holdout gate input.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False because no game oracle verifies a solve.

preconditions_checked.cuda_and_vram_receipt_source: Exp6307 terminal live canary receipts plus current snapshot
